The '''Director of Core World Operations''' was a position in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. They would oversee all SIS operations conducted in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. [[Harson Nild]] served in this position during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
